description.zh:
黑名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
- **src**：String类型，必选，黑名单IP。
> 黑名单中最多支持手动添加2000个IP。多个IP地址间使用空格或换行方式分割。
description.en:
The IP addresses to add to the blacklist. This is a JSON array. Each object in the array contains the following field:

- **src**: String. Required. The IP address to add.

> You can add up to 2,000 IP addresses per request.
The expiration time for the blacklist entries, in seconds. Valid values: **300** to **604800**.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
> 您可以调用**DescribeInstanceIds**查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro instance.

> Call the **DescribeInstanceIds** operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro instances.

title.zh: 添加针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为6次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

If you exceed the limit, your API calls are throttled, which may impact your business. To avoid throttling, call this operation at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo add-auto-cc-blacklist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --blacklist src_:_198.51.XX.XX_,_src_:_198.52.XX.XX --expire-time 300 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
